ci.why: CI is the only place the container-backed suites can run: no machine in this session has a container engine. m03-backend applies migrations to an empty database, seeds, re-applies them to a populated one and runs the suite against real PostgreSQL 17.11. m03-browser brings the real stack up and runs BOTH the standalone and browser suites.
